description: This file is a Frappe framework script that adds a custom field 'GST Category' to the 'Delivery Note' doctype, specifically for India-based companies. It first checks for companies in India, and if such companies exist, it creates a custom select field for GST categories in delivery notes.

methods.name: execute()
methods.description: Main function that adds the GST Category custom field to 'Delivery Note' doctype if there are companies based in India.
